standardNames.CVE: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (the official name; CompTIA lists Common Vulnerability Enumeration)
standardNames.DES: Data Encryption Standard (CompTIA lists Digital Encryption Standard)
standardNames.URL: Uniform Resource Locator (CompTIA lists Universal Resource Locator)
standardNames.HMAC: Hash-based Message Authentication Code (CompTIA lists Hashed Message Authentication Code)
standardNames.ISO: International Organization for Standardization (CompTIA lists International Standards Organization)
standardNames.TACACS+: Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System Plus (Cisco; encrypts the whole payload, uses TCP 49)
standardNames.PHI: Protected Health Information under HIPAA (CompTIA lists Personal Health Information)
standardNames.MTTR: Mean Time to Recover in the acronym list; objective 5.2 calls it Mean time to repair
standardNames.FIM: File Integrity Monitoring in objective 4.5 (CompTIA lists File Integrity Management)
standardNames.RAID: Redundant Array of Independent (originally Inexpensive) Disks
standardNames.FTPS: FTP over TLS (FTP Secure); not the same as SFTP, which runs over SSH
standardNames.SFTP: SSH File Transfer Protocol; not the same as FTPS, which is FTP over TLS
